items.en: \[VSCode] Added a log warning that says what to do when dictation or the extension's own requests fail certificate verification, such as behind a TLS-inspecting proxy
items.zh: \[VSCode] 新增一条日志警告，说明在听写或扩展自身请求未通过证书验证时该怎么做，例如在会检查 TLS 的代理后面

items.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near-black
items.zh: 更新内置的 dataviz skill：接受 APCA 作为文本对比度度量（在要求 AA 合规时仍保留 WCAG 2 比值），在其调色板校验脚本中新增 `apca(text, background)` 函数，并说明彩色图表填充内的标签应使用白色还是近黑色

items.en: Updated the /claude-api skill: service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations
items.zh: 更新 /claude-api skill：服务账号密钥和 Workload Identity Federation token 现在可以管理 OpenTelemetry 目标

items.en: Changed `sed -i` to get the standard Bash prompt and run as written, not a simulated file-edit preview; like other Bash edits, it is no longer restored by `/rewind`
items.zh: 变更 `sed -i`：现在会显示标准 Bash 权限提示并按原样执行，不再显示模拟的文件编辑预览；与其他 Bash 编辑一样，它不再能通过 `/rewind` 恢复

items.en: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`
items.zh: 变更 `claude ultrareview`：现在要求工作区信任，在终端上会询问，否则拒绝；脚本可传入 `--trust-workspace`（该参数不取值，PR 编号或基础分支需放在它前面），或设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`

items.en: Changed the dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` prompt in bypass permissions mode in the Desktop app and VS Code to deny the command at once with a rewrite hint, so unattended sessions keep going
items.zh: 变更桌面应用和 VS Code 中绕过权限模式下针对危险 `rm` 和 `rmdir` 的提示：现在会立即拒绝该命令并给出改写提示，使无人值守的 session 得以继续

items.en: Changed commands the settings exclude from the sandbox to ask before writing to its write-list paths while the sandbox is enabled but cannot run; the unsandboxed fallback is refused there
items.zh: 变更设置中排除在沙箱之外的命令：当沙箱已启用但无法运行时，写入其写入列表路径前会先询问；此时会拒绝非沙箱的回退

items.en: Changed worktree creation and reuse so git no longer fetches objects on demand, in ordinary clones and in partial clones with a Bash sandbox configured; such a partial clone fetches them first
items.zh: 变更 worktree 的创建和复用：git 不再按需拉取对象，适用于普通克隆以及配置了 Bash 沙箱的部分克隆；此类部分克隆会先拉取对象

items.en: Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on `multiagent_20261001` with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of `coordinator`
items.zh: 变更 `/claude-api` skill：改为在 `multiagent_20261001` 上构建 Managed Agents subagent 团队，默认启用动态工作流，不再使用 `coordinator`

items.en: Improved the speed of many git commands Claude Code runs for itself on Windows; on every platform, errors from those commands now show in English even when git is set to another language
items.zh: 改进 Claude Code 在 Windows 上自行运行的许多 git 命令的速度；在所有平台上，即使 git 设置为其他语言，这些命令的错误现在也以英文显示

items.en: Improved the error when a hooks module is nested too deep to load: it now names the file instead of showing a bare stack-overflow message
items.zh: 改进 hooks 模块嵌套过深无法加载时的错误：现在会指出文件名，而不是只显示栈溢出消息

items.en: Improved disk-full handling: a Bash command cut off by a full disk now says so and names the folder to free up, and starting on a full temp volume prints a clear message, not a raw ENOSPC error
items.zh: 改进磁盘已满的处理：因磁盘已满而中断的 Bash 命令现在会说明情况并指出需要释放空间的文件夹；在已满的临时卷上启动时会打印清晰消息，而不是原始的 ENOSPC 错误

items.en: Improved the /claude-api skill to offer API tracing alongside SDK tracing when asked to add OpenTelemetry
items.zh: 改进 /claude-api skill：在被要求添加 OpenTelemetry 时，除 SDK 追踪外还提供 API 追踪

items.en: Improved the /claude-api skill to check the live docs before saying a feature is unsupported
items.zh: 改进 /claude-api skill：在称某项功能不受支持前先检查最新文档

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved sessions that move to a new runner: Claude now sees the tool call that was interrupted, marked as outcome unknown
items.zh: 自托管运行器：改进迁移到新运行器的 session：Claude 现在能看到被中断的工具调用，并标记为结果未知

items.en: \[VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed in the chat panel: the wait for new problems after each edit is now 0.75 seconds in most cases, down from 1 to 1.5 seconds
items.zh: \[VSCode] 改进聊天面板中 Edit 和 Write 的速度：每次编辑后等待新问题的时间在大多数情况下从 1 至 1.5 秒降至 0.75 秒

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Improved a cloud session's Changes pane, which now says when it lists only pushed commits or only Claude's edits
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 改进云 session 的 Changes 面板：现在会说明它仅列出已推送的提交还是仅列出 Claude 的编辑

items.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
items.zh: 修复 macOS 和 Linux 上沙箱化的 Bash 命令在每条命令前于沙箱外运行 shell 启动文件的问题

items.en: Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink
items.zh: 修复 macOS 沙箱的 `denyWrite` glob 模式在通过符号链接到达模式所在文件夹时，未在路径的真实位置生效的问题

items.en: Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`
items.zh: 修复沙箱化命令和自动接受的编辑能够修改通过 `--mcp-config` 传入的 MCP 配置文件的问题

items.en: Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions
items.zh: 修复了在 print 和 SDK session 中，已禁用的 MCP server 被后续权限提示重新连接的问题

items.en: Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查信任某条命令设置的变量、而该命令的重定向可能无法打开的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd`
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查对某些在运行 git 前切换目录的复合命令不弹出提示的问题：当 `cd` 被包裹或带有前缀时，现在会像普通 `cd` 一样提示

items.en: Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell
items.zh: 修复了 `Edit(path)` 拒绝规则在同时包含子 shell 的某些命令中无法阻止 Bash 重定向到该路径的问题

items.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse
items.zh: 修复了 worktree 隔离的 session 接受某些带 locale 前缀命令的问题，隔离防护本应拒绝这些命令

items.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse
items.zh: 修复了 zsh 上 worktree 隔离的 session 接受某些算术命令的问题，隔离防护本应拒绝这些命令

items.en: Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 创建的 worktree 和分支检出未忽略 git replace refs 的问题，其其他 git 操作已如此处理

items.en: Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink
items.zh: 修复了通过符号链接访问配置目录时 profile 存储写保护不生效的问题

items.en: Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start
items.zh: 修复了读取超大嵌套 CLAUDE.md 下的文件后 session 反复进行上下文压缩的问题；超过大小限制的嵌套 CLAUDE.md 现在只加载开头部分

items.en: Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running
items.zh: 修复了 ctrl+enter（立即发送）的问题：在响应开始前按下时只会将消息排队；在 prompt 的 hook 运行期间按下时会重启该 prompt 的 hook，却仍将消息留在队列中

items.en: Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode
items.zh: 修复了绑定按键的斜杠命令在 `!` 模式下于 shell 中运行的问题

items.en: Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting
items.zh: 修复了 ctrl+o 不显示其他 agent 和 session 中仍在等待投递的消息的问题；这些消息现在会完整显示在对话记录下方，并标记为等待中

items.en: Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse
items.zh: 修复了较长的工具输出预览在 emoji 中间被截断、导致 `jq` 无法解析 session 对话记录的问题

items.en: Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc`
items.zh: 修复了在共享父进程 `/proc` 的 Linux 沙箱中，Read 对 PDF 页码范围报告“File does not exist”的问题

items.en: Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed
items.zh: 修复了由 Claude Desktop 托管的 session 在连接刷新时消息有时丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization
items.zh: 修复了当同一台电脑上的终端登录了其他账户或组织时，Claude 桌面应用中的 Claude Code session 缺少功能的问题

items.en: Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository
items.zh: 修复了 `claude remote-control` 状态栏对不在 git 仓库中的文件夹将 `HEAD` 显示为分支的问题

items.en: Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line
items.zh: 修复了分屏 agent 队友不继承 leader 命令行上指定的工具拒绝规则和 `--tools` 规则的问题

items.en: Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`
items.zh: 修复了用 `/rename` 重命名的 session 在 VS Code 窗口重新加载或非交互式 `--resume` 后，在其他 session 中以生成名称出现的问题

items.en: Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command
items.zh: 修复了 `/rewind` 列表对通过 `/code-review --fix`、subagent 或 shell 命令更改了检查点文件的轮次显示“No code changes”的问题

items.en: Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched
items.zh: 修复 `/privacy-settings` 显示过时的“Help improve our AI models”值的问题；现在当该设置无法获取时也会给出提示

items.en: Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug
items.zh: 修复组织不接受反馈时反馈提示“try again later”的问题；现在会显示服务器给出的原因以及报告 bug 的位置

items.en: Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript
items.zh: 修复过大的 /feedback 报告发送失败、而不是在不含对话记录的情况下重新发送的问题

items.en: Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`
items.zh: 修复当另一个 skill 已占用同名时，`--add-dir` 文件夹中的 skill 无法访问的问题；现在会以 `<folder>:<name>` 的形式提供

items.en: Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell
items.zh: 修复当嵌套包的文件从 shell 中被修改后，`/verify` 和 `/code-review` 找不到该包自身的 skill 的问题

items.en: Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command
items.zh: 修复 /claude-api skill 称 `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` 会向命令传递 trace 上下文的问题

items.en: Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients
items.zh: 修复 /claude-api skill 的 C# 追踪配置缺少云平台客户端 span 的问题

items.en: Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's trace
items.zh: 修复 /claude-api skill 称发往 Claude Platform on AWS 的请求的 API span 无法加入调用方 trace 的问题

items.en: Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2, and on Windows `PreToolUse` and `PermissionRequest` hooks with `"shell": "powershell"` failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed
items.zh: 修复在 PowerShell 中运行的 hook 在 hook 程序以退出码 2 退出时不阻断的问题，以及 Windows 上 `"shell": "powershell"` 的 `PreToolUse` 和 `PermissionRequest` hook 在未安装 Git for Windows 时失败放行的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook that names a model by alias, such as `haiku`, failing every request with a model error: the alias now resolves to its model
items.zh: 修复 mod 的 `turn.step` hook 通过别名（如 `haiku`）指定模型时，每个请求都因模型错误而失败的问题：现在别名会解析为对应模型

items.en: Fixed plugins and skills synced from claude.ai being removed, sometimes mid-session, after a disk read error
items.zh: 修复从 claude.ai 同步的 plugin 和 skill 在磁盘读取错误后被移除（有时发生在 session 中途）的问题

items.en: Fixed artifact publishes and updates being refused for some ordinary pages, such as pages with certain minified scripts or artifacts Claude could not read first
items.zh: 修复某些普通页面（例如包含特定压缩脚本的页面，或 Claude 无法先行读取的 artifact）的 artifact 发布和更新被拒绝的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude asking for permission on each artifact update for the rest of a turn after the conversation was compacted in that turn
items.zh: 修复在某一轮对话中执行上下文压缩后，该轮剩余时间内 Claude 每次更新 artifact 都会请求权限的问题

items.en: Fixed fine-grained tool streaming staying off on Amazon Bedrock when `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is set to the default `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` endpoint
items.zh: 修复当 `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` 设为默认的 `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` 端点时，Amazon Bedrock 上细粒度工具流式传输保持关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed the "Waiting for API response" hint flickering behind gateways that send only keepalive pings: routes off Anthropic's backend now wait 45 seconds
items.zh: 修复在仅发送 keepalive ping 的网关后面“Waiting for API response”提示闪烁的问题：不走 Anthropic 后端的路由现在等待 45 秒

items.en: Fixed Claude notifying unrelated GitHub users by writing role names and placeholders as mentions in PRs, issues and comments
items.zh: 修复 Claude 在 PR、issue 和评论中将角色名和占位符写成提及，从而通知无关 GitHub 用户的问题

items.en: Linux: Fixed sandbox write denies lifting when a background command outlived the session
items.zh: Linux：修复当后台命令的生命周期超过 session 时，沙箱写入拒绝被解除的问题

items.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell permission checks auto-approving some `Set-Location` or `cd` commands that target the current directory and carry extra arguments; these now prompt for approval
items.zh: Windows：修复 PowerShell 权限检查自动批准某些针对当前目录且带有额外参数的 `Set-Location` 或 `cd` 命令的问题；这些命令现在会请求批准

items.en: macOS: Fixed the "Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog opening each time Claude Code starts on a Mac without Xcode or the Command Line Tools
items.zh: macOS：修复在未安装 Xcode 或 Command Line Tools 的 Mac 上，每次启动 Claude Code 都会弹出“Install Command Line Developer Tools”对话框的问题

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--startup-timeout-min` stopping a session whose first prompt, such as `/code-review`, was still working in a subagent; a frozen process is still stopped
items.zh: 自托管运行器：修复 `--startup-timeout-min` 会停止首个 prompt（如 `/code-review`）仍在 subagent 中运行的 session 的问题；进程冻结时仍会停止

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the Claude panel staying blank after the editor cached an incomplete copy of its files; it now recovers by itself, or says what went wrong and how to fix it
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了编辑器缓存了不完整的文件副本后 Claude 面板一直空白的问题；现在它会自行恢复，或说明出了什么问题以及如何修复

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed Session history filling up with empty "Untitled" sessions each time you start a new session without sending a message
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了每次开始新 session 但未发送消息时，Session 历史记录中会填满空的“Untitled” session 的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed long slash-command messages such as `/goal` filling the chat panel; they now fold behind Show more like other prompts (anthropics/claude-code#97469)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 `/goal` 等较长的斜杠命令消息占满聊天面板的问题；现在它们会像其他 prompt 一样折叠在“显示更多”之后（anthropics/claude-code#97469）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed long messages not folding behind Show more after the chat panel is made narrower
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了聊天面板变窄后，长消息不会折叠在“显示更多”之后的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of \~/.claude/keybindings.json
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了聊天输入框中 Ctrl+J 总是插入换行的问题：当在 `~/.claude/keybindings.json` 的 Chat 上下文中将“ctrl+j”设为 null 时，现在交由 VS Code 和操作系统处理

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a mod's "From the … plugin" label above the prompt being drawn over the slash command and @-mention menus (anthropics/claude-code#102981)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 prompt 上方 mod 的“From the … plugin”标签会覆盖在斜杠命令和 @ 提及菜单上的问题（anthropics/claude-code#102981）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed an empty list item, paragraph or code block, and list items renumbered from 1, when pasting copied LaTeX math
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了粘贴复制的 LaTeX 数学公式时出现空列表项、空段落或空代码块，以及列表项从 1 重新编号的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the feedback error showing only an HTTP status when your organization does not accept feedback
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了组织不接受反馈时，反馈错误只显示 HTTP 状态码的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Add connector list in routine forms saying no connectors were available while they were still loading
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了例程表单中的“添加 connector”列表在 connector 仍在加载时显示没有可用 connector 的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed the cloud environment editor shuffling environment variables and adding backslashes to values that contain both kinds of quote
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了云环境编辑器打乱环境变量顺序，以及为同时包含两种引号的值添加反斜杠的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings so its title, tabs and buttons stay in view while only the content scrolls
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了管理设置中自托管环境详情对话框的问题，现在其标题、标签页和按钮保持可见，仅内容区域滚动

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "read documentation" tool row in cloud sessions, which showed escaped JSON instead of a readable page
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了云 session 中“读取文档”工具行显示转义 JSON 而非可读页面的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a draft you approved for a channel into your DM by mistake; a post with no channel is now refused so it can go to the approved channel
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Slack 中的 Claude 将你为某个频道批准的草稿误发到你的私信中的问题；现在没有频道的帖子会被拒绝，以便发送到已批准的频道

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Allow and Deny on Claude's approval cards in Slack doing nothing when the session had stopped; your answer now restarts the session
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 session 已停止时，Slack 中 Claude 审批卡片上的“允许”和“拒绝”按钮无响应的问题；现在你的回答会重新启动 session

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude ignoring untagged messages in a Slack channel after its workspace moved to a different Claude organization, including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了工作区迁移到其他 Claude 组织后，Claude 忽略 Slack 频道中未标记消息的问题，包括 Enterprise Grid 上未共享的频道

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack channel posting a threaded reply before reading a newer message someone had just added to that thread
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Slack 频道中的 Claude 在读取他人刚添加到该线程的较新消息之前就发布线程回复的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack page in Claude Tag admin settings saying no workspaces were connected when the list failed to load; it now shows an error with a Retry button
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude Tag 管理设置中的 Slack 页面在列表加载失败时显示未连接任何工作区的问题；现在会显示错误和“重试”按钮

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed a finished review showing no check on the pull request when earlier tries to create it failed; a final try now adds a completed check
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复了先前创建检查失败时，已完成的审查在拉取请求上不显示检查的问题；现在最后一次尝试会添加已完成的检查

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed a push queued behind a running review still starting a review after `@claude review stop`; its check now closes and says why
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复了在 `@claude review stop` 之后，排队等待正在运行的审查的推送仍会启动审查的问题；现在其检查会关闭并说明原因

summary.tldr: 强化沙箱与权限校验，修复大量安全与稳定性问题，并调整 sed -i 与 ultrareview 行为。

highlights.title: sed -i 改为标准 Bash 权限
highlights.detail: sed -i 不再显示模拟文件编辑预览，改为走标准 Bash 权限提示并按原样执行；与其他 Bash 编辑一样无法通过 /rewind 恢复。
highlights.action: 依赖 /rewind 撤销 sed -i 改动的用户需改用其他方式备份或恢复文件。

highlights.title: ultrareview 需工作区信任
highlights.detail: claude ultrareview 现在要求工作区信任，终端会询问，否则拒绝执行；脚本场景需显式传入信任参数或设置环境变量。
highlights.action: 脚本中调用时传入 --trust-workspace（放在 PR 编号或基础分支之前），或设置 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1。

highlights.title: 修复沙箱与权限绕过
highlights.detail: 修复沙箱化 Bash 在沙箱外执行 shell 启动文件、符号链接下 denyWrite 失效、沙箱命令可修改 --mcp-config 文件，以及多处 Bash 权限检查漏提示或误放行的问题。

highlights.title: 磁盘已满提示更清晰
highlights.detail: 因磁盘已满中断的 Bash 命令会说明原因并指出需释放空间的文件夹；在已满临时卷上启动时打印明确消息而非原始 ENOSPC 错误。

highlights.title: 修复上下文反复压缩
highlights.detail: 读取超大嵌套 CLAUDE.md 下的文件后不再反复触发上下文压缩；超限的嵌套 CLAUDE.md 只加载开头部分。

highlights.title: VSCode 与桌面端多项修复
highlights.detail: 修复 VSCode 面板空白、空 Untitled session 堆积、长消息不折叠、Ctrl+J 换行等问题，并提升 Edit/Write 响应速度。
